name: factlot
description: Commercial real estate skills plus the FactLot MCP tools: deterministic, audited calculators for loan sizing and amortization, lease economics, CAM, ASC 842, returns, DCF and direct-cap valuation, LP/GP waterfalls, 1031 exchanges, multifamily rent rolls, capex recovery, hotel metrics, the Texas protest deadline, and the Texas unequal-appraisal arithmetic (not an appraisal or an opinion of value, and not a substitute for the advice of an attorney).
